privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Last updated: 21.11.2026. Applies to the Macrolia app and the macrolia.app website.

1. In short

  • Everything you enter in Macrolia is stored only on your phone. We don't see it.
  • The exception is AI photos: the photo is sent for recognition and is not stored.
  • No ads, no tracking tools or behaviour analytics, no cookies on the website. We don't sell data.

2. Data controller

[Company name], [address], Austria, email: support@upliftinlife.com. We are not required to have a data protection officer; for all questions, write to this email.

3. What data, where, why and for how long

  • Sex, age, height, weight, activity, goal: only on the phone; for the daily limit and macros; legal basis: explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR); kept until you delete them.
  • Diary, products, recipes, plan for tomorrow, weight, progress photos: only on the phone; for the core features; legal basis: explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR); kept until you delete them.
  • Burned calories and steps from Health Connect: only on the phone; for the daily limit; legal basis: explicit consent and Android permission; kept until you delete the data or stop access.
  • AI photo of a label or dish: passes through our server (Cloudflare) to Anthropic; to recognise the values or the food; legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and consent at the first AI photo; we don't keep it, Anthropic deletes it within 30 days.
  • AI photo counter (random app number, month, count) and photos from extra packs: our server (Cloudflare); for the monthly limit (40 labels + 20 meals) and bought photos; legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); the monthly counter is deleted after 40 days, the number of bought photos is kept until you use them.
  • IP address and technical request data for AI photos: Cloudflare; for delivery and protection against attacks; legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); we don't record them.
  • Whether the subscription is active: Google Play and the phone; for access to the paid features; legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); for as long as the subscription lasts.
  • Emails to support@upliftinlife.com: the Zoho email service (data centres in the EU); to answer your question; legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(f) GDPR; up to 3 years after the last message.
  • Visits to macrolia.app (IP address, browser, time): GitHub Pages hosting; to show and protect the website; legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); we have no access to this data, GitHub keeps it under its privacy policy.

Macrolia doesn't ask for your name, email, address or date of birth and has no user account. Reminders in the app are created on the phone itself and don't go through us.

4. Health data and your consent

Weight, food intake, body photos, burned calories and steps are health-related data, i.e. a special category of data under the GDPR. We process them only with your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), which you give at first start. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your data in Settings or uninstalling the app. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before it.

5. Health Connect

If you turn on “Automatic tracking”, Macrolia reads from Health Connect only actively burned calories and steps, and only after your permission in Android. We write nothing to Health Connect.

We use this data solely for your daily limit in the app. It stays on the phone, is not sent to our server, not sold, not shared with others, not used for advertising and not used to train AI. Its use complies with Google's Health Connect policies, including the Limited Use requirements. You can stop access at any time in the app's or the phone's settings.

6. AI photos

When you photograph a label or dish with AI, the photo is sent encrypted to our server at Cloudflare and from there to the AI service Claude by Anthropic PBC (USA), only so that the food or the label's values can be recognised. Along with the photo, the app's language and a random app number are sent, without your name, email or other data about you.

We don't store the photo. Anthropic processes it on our behalf as a processor, doesn't use it to train AI and deletes it within 30 days. Before the first AI photo the app explains this and you can decline. Please photograph only the food, without people.

The result is a suggestion that you check and save. AI does not make decisions about you.

7. Backup

If Android backup is turned on on your phone, Android keeps an encrypted copy of the data in your Google account so it can restore it on a new phone. This copy is stored by Google in your Google account; we have no access to it. You turn it off in the phone's Settings → Google → Backup.

If you save a backup to a file yourself, you choose where to keep it. The file is not encrypted, so keep it somewhere safe. The same applies to PDF and Excel reports that you download or send to someone.

8. Payments

Subscriptions and extra AI photo packs are bought through Google Play. Payment data is processed by Google as an independent controller under its Privacy Policy. We don't receive your card details, only information on whether the subscription is active and which packs were bought, and summarised sales reports from Google.

9. Who else receives data

Processors acting on our behalf, under a data processing agreement:

  • Cloudflare, Inc. (USA): our server for AI photos and the counter.
  • Anthropic PBC (USA): recognition of AI photos.
  • Zoho Corporation B.V. (Netherlands): the support@upliftinlife.com email.
  • GitHub, Inc. (USA): hosting of the macrolia.app website.

Independent controllers: Google (Google Play, payments, Android backup), under your agreements with Google.

Data transfers to the USA are based on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework where the provider is certified under it, or on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

We don't sell data or share it for advertising. If we add a new provider, we will update this Policy first.

10. Security

The connection to our server and to the website is encrypted (HTTPS). Data on the phone is protected by Android's security, so we advise you to lock your phone.

11. Children

Macrolia is for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

12. Deleting data

You delete everything in Settings → “Delete all data” or by uninstalling the app. The data is permanently deleted from the phone. The Google backup and files you saved yourself are deleted separately. The subscription is cancelled in Google Play.

13. Your rights

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability (the backup file and the Excel reports serve this purpose), objection to processing based on legitimate interest, and withdrawal of consent at any time. Write to us at support@upliftinlife.com.

You also have the right to complain to a supervisory authority: in Austria this is the Datenschutzbehörde (dsb.gv.at), and you can also contact the authority in the country where you live.

14. Changes

When the app or the law changes, we update this Policy. We inform you about significant changes in the app, and if a change requires new consent, we will ask for it beforehand.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body:
Last updated: 21.11.2026

1. Who provides Macrolia

The Macrolia app (“the app”) is provided by [Company name], [address], Austria, [company register number], email: support@upliftinlife.com (“we”). Our full details are in the Impressum on macrolia.app.

These Terms govern the use of the app and of its subscriptions.

2. What Macrolia does

Macrolia helps you calculate and track calories, nutrients, food intake, recipes and personal nutrition goals. You can enter your own products and values, create recipes, calculate the portions you actually ate, plan the next day and track your weight.

3. Who may use Macrolia

Macrolia is intended for people aged 18 and over.

The app is not suitable and must not be used to change weight without medical supervision during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or with a current or past eating disorder (for example anorexia or bulimia).

If you are over 65, have a medical condition (for example diabetes, heart or kidney disease) or take medication, talk to a doctor before you change your diet.

4. Not medical advice

Macrolia is intended for information and education. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose or treat, and does not replace advice from a doctor, dietitian or other health professional.

5. Calculations and accuracy

Macrolia calculates from the information you enter: nutritional values, amounts, recipes and ingredients, weight or number of portions, the amount actually eaten, personal data and goals.

When you enter the values from the label of a specific product, Macrolia uses exactly those values.

Pre-loaded products use values from official food composition tables (USDA FoodData Central, the Swiss Food Composition Database and the German Nutrient Database BLS 4.0 of the Max Rubner-Institut), and a few special products use the values from the label of a named product. Each product shows its source. Products usually bought with a label (for example milk, cheese, ham) have average values, and your brand may differ. Natural products vary by variety, ripeness and origin, so the real values may differ slightly.

Values marked with ≈ (for example restaurant food or amounts estimated by eye) are approximate.

Daily goals are calculated with generally accepted formulas and are an estimate for an average person with your data. Your actual energy use and the actual pace of weight change may differ.

The accuracy of the results depends on the accuracy of the information entered. We do not guarantee the accuracy of information entered by you or stated by a product's manufacturer.

6. AI photos

Recognising a label or a dish from a photo uses artificial intelligence (AI). The result is a suggestion that may contain errors, such as a misread number on the label or an inaccurately estimated amount on the plate. Please check and, if needed, correct the values before you save them. The estimate of a dish from a photo is always approximate (≈).

Photograph only food and labels, without people, documents or other personal information.

The subscription includes 60 AI photos per calendar month: 40 for labels and 20 for meals. Monthly photos are valid until the end of that month, and unused ones do not carry over to the next month; on the 1st you start again with 40 for labels and 20 for meals. A photo in which AI did not recognise a label or food is not counted.

If you need more, you can buy an extra photo pack through Google Play. Photos from extra packs are used after the monthly ones, work for labels and meals, and unused ones carry over to the next month with no end date. You can use them while you have an active subscription; if the subscription stops, they are kept until you renew it. All other features work without AI too, with manual entry.

7. Mode below the recommended minimum

By default Macrolia does not set a daily limit below 1200 kcal for women and 1500 kcal for men. If you explicitly choose “faster pace at your own risk”, the limit can be lower, but never below 800 kcal.

By choosing this option you confirm that you have read the warning that Macrolia does not recommend this mode for your data, and that you use it at your own risk. We recommend this mode only after consulting a doctor.

8. Personal decisions and health

The results and goals in Macrolia help you track and plan your eating. They are not a medical recommendation.

You decide about your own eating, exercise and health. If you feel unwell, dizzy, very tired or have other complaints, stop the plan and consult a doctor.

9. Your information and your content

You are responsible for the information you enter: products, values, amounts, recipes, weight and other data. Check it when accuracy matters for your health.

The recipes, photos and notes you create remain yours. They are only on your phone and we do not receive them.

10. Subscriptions and free trial

Without a subscription you can look through the whole app and go through the short “First steps” tutorial. To save data and use AI photos, you need a subscription.

Plans:

  • Monthly: you pay every month and can stop at any time.
  • Yearly: you pay once a year. The first year may be at a lower introductory price; after that the subscription renews at the regular price shown at purchase.

Before purchase, Google Play shows the exact price including taxes, the duration, the trial period and the date of the first payment.

Free trial: with your first subscription you may get 7 days free, under Google Play's rules. If you don't cancel before the trial ends, the subscription moves to the paid plan you chose.

Renewal and cancellation: the subscription renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel it. You cancel it in Google Play → Profile → Payments and subscriptions. After cancelling, you can use the subscription until the end of the paid period. Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription.

Price changes: if we change the price of an active subscription, Google Play informs you in advance. If the price goes up, you can cancel before it takes effect.

Purchases and payments are made through Google Play and under its rules.

Codes for free access: at our discretion we may give one-time Google Play codes. A code is tied to the Google account it was redeemed with and may not be sold.

11. Right of withdrawal within 14 days

If you are a consumer in the EU, you have the right to withdraw from the subscription within 14 days of concluding it, without giving a reason. To withdraw, send us a clear message at support@upliftinlife.com or request a refund through Google Play. It is enough to send the message before the period ends.

If you withdraw within this period, we refund the full amount paid, without deductions, even if you have already used the paid period. The refund is made through Google Play to the original payment method, without undue delay and no later than 14 days after your message, and the subscription ends. Please include the order number from Google's email (it starts with “GPA.”).

12. Termination

You can stop using Macrolia at any time by cancelling the subscription and deleting the app.

We may suspend access to AI photos in case of misuse, for example automated sending of photos or attempts to get around the limit. If possible, we will try to contact you first.

13. Liability

We do our best to make the app and AI photos work correctly. If something doesn't work, we will fix it or refund you as required by law. Short interruptions of AI photos caused by external providers are possible.

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damage arising from using the app or from decisions made based on its calculations.

Nothing in these Terms limits our liability for intent or gross negligence, for harm to life and health, or in other cases where the law does not allow such a limitation. They also do not affect your statutory rights as a consumer, including the warranty for digital content and services.

14. Intellectual property

The Macrolia name, logo, design, software, texts and original content of the app are protected by law. You may use them only for personal use within the app; copying and distributing them requires our prior permission.

15. Changes to the app and to the Terms

We may update and improve Macrolia. If a change significantly worsens a feature you have paid for, we will inform you in advance and you can end your subscription free of charge.

If we change these Terms in a way that affects your rights, we will show you the change in the app and ask you to accept it with an “I accept” button. If you don't accept it, you can end the subscription and we will refund the amount for the unused paid period. Minor corrections that don't affect your rights (for example typos or contact details) are made without separate acceptance.

16. Applicable law and disputes

These Terms are governed by Austrian law, excluding its conflict-of-law rules. If you are a consumer habitually resident in another country, you keep the protection of the mandatory provisions of the law of your country and can go to the court where you live.

Before going to court, please write to us at support@upliftinlife.com: we will do our best to resolve any problem amicably. We also take part in out-of-court dispute resolution before the Internet Ombudsstelle (www.ombudsstelle.at), which is free for you.

17. Language versions

These Terms are translated into all languages of the app. All language versions are equally valid.

18. Privacy and contact

How we process your data is described in the Privacy Policy. For questions, write to support@upliftinlife.com.
